name: 20 vs 1: Pop The Balloon🎈
desc:
🎈 20 v 1: Pop the Balloon 🎈

Brand new game mode!

Step into the arena where your style and survival are judged by everyone around you!

✨ Dress & Survive:
Dress your best, impress the crowd, and earn more likes than dislikes to stay in the game. If not… your balloon pops!

🤖 Automation Mode:
Jump into fast-paced, automatic rounds where every decision counts. How long can you survive?

🎮 Manual Mode:
Join live-hosted games with custom rules and unpredictable challenges. Expect the unexpected!

🌟 Whether you're competing, voting, or spectating, every round brings something new.

👍 Like & favorite the game to support future updates!

⚠️ Disclaimer: This game is for entertainment purposes only and is not affiliated with any real-life events or creators.
